thread:
maria_marketing: Quick sync — we should lock the webinar creative this week. Working title: 'Production Playbooks for Serving LLMs: Predictable Cost, Low Latency'. Need speaker bios (1 line), headshots, and 2 promotional captions from each speaker by Tue. Also accessibility & post-webinar plan (transcript, clips).

tom_product: Title looks good. I'll cover model routing and the product tradeoffs. 1-line bio + caption coming monday.

kevin_sdr: For leads: want a tag schema: webinar:production_playbooks, demo_interest (yes/no), company_size bucket. If demo_interest=yes -> route to SDR; if company_size>1000 mark AE_high.

anya_design: Slide template request: I'll make an accessible version (WCAG AA colors) and a 16:9 speaker slide + 1-slide TL;DR artwork. Also need all bios/headshots by Tue to make social images.

sam_ops: Ops notes: we must enable live captions and record to S3. Can we confirm vendor for captions? Otter/Rev? Also need a staging recording bucket and retention policy (30 days public link, archive).

maria_marketing: Good call. We'll use Otter for live captions and Rev for post-edit transcript. Sam, can you coordinate the bucket and perms?

sam_ops: Yep. @deploy-bot can you provision webinar-recording-bucket in staging and set ACL to redact by default?

deploy-bot: Created bucket staging-webinar-records-1805. Upload endpoint: s3://staging-webinar-records-1805. Shared IAM role in DM. ETA 5m.

julie_growth: Promo cadence: 3 emails (invite, reminder, last-chance) + 2 LinkedIn posts. Need 2 short quotes per speaker and 1 customer stat for the landing page. Also want a gated benchmark packet for registrants.

maria_marketing: Landing page checklist: title, 3 bullets (what you'll learn), speaker carousel, registration form (company, role, painpoint poll), consent checkbox for follow-up. Julie: we'll do gated benchmark PDF with rounded numbers.

kevin_sdr: Routing rules: if painpoint=cost & company_size>200 -> tag priority_cost and assign to kevin_sdr queue. If painpoint=latency & infra=true -> tag priority_latency and route to infra-AE. Add 'webinar_clip_request' tag if they request clip.

anya_design: Accessibility specifics: high-contrast color palette, alt text for all images, live caption fallback on slides (place speaker notes with timecodes), font size >= 28 for body. I'll produce final deck template by Thu.

tom_product: Demo plan: 8-minute live demo (pre-recorded backup) showing routing failover + cost delta table. Will include command snippet in notes. Example snippet for landing page UTM: `?utm_source=email&utm_medium=webinar&utm_campaign=production_playbooks`.

maria_marketing: Recording & rights: confirm speakers are ok with clips being used in promotions (short 30s clips). We'll add consent checkbox to registration and a short speaker release in the speaker pack.

sam_ops: Speakers: please confirm whether you want raw recording retained beyond 90 days. Default retention = 90d unless you opt-in to archive.

tom_product: Archive ok for me 90d. Fine with clips.

kevin_sdr: Post-webinar routing timeline: ingest registrant list into CRM within 1h of webinar end, tag and score, SDRs get hot leads (<24h outreach). Can we automate via Zapier or Segment?

julie_growth: We'll use Segment -> CRM job. Julie will own the Zap mapping.

maria_marketing: Rehearsal plan: full run 48h before, tech-check 30m on the morning of. Backup plan: pre-recorded demo + a trained moderator who can do Qs if live speaker drops.

anya_design: I'll add a 1-slide visual with backup instructions for the moderator.

sam_ops: Tech checklist for rehearsal: 1) captions enabled 2) share screen test 3) audio mic check 4) pre-recorded demo loaded as fallback 5) recording verified. I'll DM the checklist.

deploy-bot: Recording job scheduled. Post-webinar clip extraction job: `extract-clips --input s3://staging-webinar-records-1805 --timestamps 00:05:00,00:15:00,00:35:00 --out s3://marketing-clips/production_playbooks`. Will run on webinar end.

maria_marketing: Deadlines: speakers assets + captions consent by Tue EOD. Decks to marketing by Thu. Landing page live by next Mon. Anything else?

tom_product: Need a single slide with key numbers for benchmark packet by Fri.

kevin_sdr: Also request: include a question on the form \"Would you like a technical follow-up?\" to help routing.

maria_marketing: Added. I'll follow up with a consolidated speaker brief and the promo calendar after this thread. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
